6.290 rsInvalidUnicodeBiDi
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsInvalidUnicodeBiDi is a critical error that occurs when a Style.UnicodeBiDi element is set to a
constant String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) that is not one of its valid values.
